doc_title: APPLICATION FOR CONSENT OF LAND CONTROL BOARD
doc_title_official: APPLICATION FOR CONSENT OF LAND CONTROL BOARD
made_under: The Land Control Regulations (L.N. 23 of 1968), Schedule, Form 1, prescribed by regulation 2 and required by section 8(1) of the Land Control Act (Cap. 302)
when_used: Applies to the land control board for consent to a controlled transaction in agricultural land within a land control area. Section 6(1) of the Land Control Act makes the transaction void for all purposes without that consent, and section 8(1) requires the application within six months of the agreement, in this prescribed form.
registry_block: Signature of purchaser, lessee, mortgagee, chargee or authorized agent or agents, etc.: …………………………………………………………………

body_text.text: To be submitted in TRIPLICATE in respect of each transaction and sent to or left at the appropriate office of the Commissioner of Lands.
To: The {{land_control_board}} Land Control Board.  Official reference: {{official_reference}}
I Hereby apply to the {{land_control_board}} Land Control Board for its consent to the transaction described below, and give the following information—
body_text.text_official: I Hereby apply to the ................................ Land Control Board for its consent to the transaction described below, and give the following information—

body_text.text: 3.Nature of transaction (e.g. sale, gift, lease, mortgage, charge, etc.; if sale or allotment of shares, name of company, number and particulars of shares to be transferred) {{transaction_nature}}

4.Term (i.e. the length of time for which the land affected is to be transferred or leased: if sale or allotment of shares, authorized share capital of the company and numbers of shares issued at date of application) {{transaction_term}}

7.If a transfer or lease of the land—Proposed development programme of purchaser, including funds available therefor with approximate dates {{development_programme}}
Does the purchaser/lessee intend to reside on the land? {{intends_to_reside}}
We hereby declare that the above information is true to the best of our knowledge and belief.

foot_notes: If spaces allowed under any particular item are insufficient for the information, a separate sheet with item numbers and duly signed by all parties or their authorized agent or agents should be attached.

custom_fields.name: land_control_board
custom_fields.label: Land control board
custom_fields.prompt: Item heading: the board's place name only, e.g. Kikuyu. The form already prints the words Land Control Board after it, so write Kikuyu, not Kikuyu Land Control Board.

custom_fields.name: vendor_nationality
custom_fields.label: Nationality of the present registered holder
custom_fields.prompt: Item 1(b): the nationality of the present registered holder (the seller, donor, lessor or chargor), e.g. Kenyan.

custom_fields.name: vendor_address
custom_fields.label: Address of the present registered holder
custom_fields.prompt: Item 1(c): the holder's postal address, e.g. P.O. Box 10-00902 Kikuyu.

custom_fields.name: purchaser_nationality
custom_fields.label: Nationality of the proposed purchaser or transferee
custom_fields.prompt: Item 2(c): the nationality of the purchaser, transferee, lessee, chargee or allottee, e.g. Kenyan.

custom_fields.name: purchaser_address
custom_fields.label: Address of the proposed purchaser or transferee
custom_fields.prompt: Item 2(d): the purchaser's postal address, e.g. P.O. Box 20-00902 Kikuyu.

custom_fields.name: transaction_nature
custom_fields.label: Nature of transaction
custom_fields.prompt: Item 3: what the transaction is, e.g. Sale, Gift, Lease or Charge. For a sale or allotment of shares, add the company's name and the number and particulars of the shares.

custom_fields.name: acreage
custom_fields.label: Acreage
custom_fields.prompt: Item 5: the area of the land as the title gives it, with its unit, e.g. 0.8094 Ha (two acres).

custom_fields.name: county
custom_fields.label: County (the form's County Council)
custom_fields.prompt: Item 5, the County Council line: the county in which the land lies, e.g. Kiambu.

custom_fields.name: purchase_price_figures
custom_fields.label: Purchase price in figures
custom_fields.prompt: Item 6(a), for a sale or option: the purchase price in figures without the currency, e.g. 6,500,000 (the form prints Sh. before it). Leave out only for a gift, lease, mortgage or charge.

custom_fields.name: official_reference
custom_fields.label: Official reference
custom_fields.prompt: The board's own reference, where one has been given. Leave out if none.

custom_fields.name: purchaser_company_particulars
custom_fields.label: Company or society particulars
custom_fields.prompt: Item 2(b), only where the purchaser is a limited company or a co-operative society: for a company, its directors, authorised and issued share capital and principal shareholders; for a society, its chairman, secretary, treasurer and total number of members. Leave out for an individual.

custom_fields.name: purchaser_certificate_no
custom_fields.label: Certificate No.
custom_fields.prompt: Item 2(c), the Certificate No. printed beside the purchaser's nationality, where the purchaser holds one (for example a company's certificate of incorporation or a society's certificate of registration). Leave out if none.

custom_fields.name: transaction_term
custom_fields.label: Term
custom_fields.prompt: Item 4: for a lease, the length of the term; for a sale or allotment of shares, the company's authorised share capital and the number of shares issued at the date of application. Leave out to leave the item blank for completion by hand.

custom_fields.name: rent
custom_fields.label: Rent
custom_fields.prompt: Item 6(a), for a lease: the rent in figures, e.g. 120,000 a year. Leave out otherwise.

custom_fields.name: gift_value
custom_fields.label: Estimated value of the land (gift)
custom_fields.prompt: Item 6(a), for a gift: the estimated value of the land in figures. Leave out otherwise.

custom_fields.name: loan_amount
custom_fields.label: Amount of loan
custom_fields.prompt: Item 6(a), for a mortgage or charge: the amount of the loan in figures. Leave out otherwise.

custom_fields.name: interest_rate
custom_fields.label: Rate of interest
custom_fields.prompt: Item 6(a), for a mortgage or charge: the rate of interest as a number, e.g. 13 (the form prints % after it). Leave out otherwise.

custom_fields.name: crops_information
custom_fields.label: Crops and other information affecting the consideration
custom_fields.prompt: Item 6(a): any other information affecting the amount of the consideration, particularly the description and area of crops, with their estimated yields and value, included in the purchase price. Leave out if none.

custom_fields.name: improvements
custom_fields.label: Improvements included in the consideration
custom_fields.prompt: Item 6(b): a full description and the approximate value of improvements on the land included in the consideration. Leave out if none.

custom_fields.name: other_consideration
custom_fields.label: Other consideration
custom_fields.prompt: Item 6(c): any other consideration passing between the parties. Leave out if none.

custom_fields.name: development_programme
custom_fields.label: Development programme
custom_fields.prompt: Item 7, on a transfer or lease: the purchaser's proposed development programme for the land, including the funds available for it and approximate dates. Leave out if none is proposed.

custom_fields.name: intends_to_reside
custom_fields.label: Will the purchaser reside on the land?
custom_fields.prompt: Item 7, on a transfer or lease: does the purchaser or lessee intend to reside on the land? Answer Yes or No. Leave out to leave it for completion by hand.

custom_fields.name: other_land_parcels
custom_fields.label: Other agricultural land: L.R. or parcel numbers
custom_fields.prompt: Item 8(a): other agricultural land registered in the name of, or held under contract for sale by, the purchaser, the purchaser's immediate family or a company the purchaser has an interest in. Give the L.R. or parcel numbers, or write Nil if there is none. Leave out to complete by hand.

custom_fields.name: other_land_acreage
custom_fields.label: Other agricultural land: acreage
custom_fields.prompt: Item 8(a): the acreage of that other land. Leave out if none.

custom_fields.name: other_land_owner
custom_fields.label: Other agricultural land: owner
custom_fields.prompt: Item 8(a): the owner of that other land. Leave out if none.

custom_fields.name: other_land_interest
custom_fields.label: Other agricultural land: nature of interest
custom_fields.prompt: Item 8(a): the nature of the interest in that land and, where it is held through a company, the nature of the purchaser's interest in the company. Leave out if none.

custom_fields.name: other_land_contiguous
custom_fields.label: Other agricultural land: contiguous?
custom_fields.prompt: Item 8(a): whether that land is contiguous to the land being purchased, Yes or No. Leave out if none.

custom_fields.name: disposed_land_parcels
custom_fields.label: Land held and disposed of in the last three years: L.R. or parcel numbers
custom_fields.prompt: Item 8(b): agricultural land the purchaser or lessee has held and disposed of in the last three years. Give the L.R. or parcel numbers, or write Nil if there is none. Leave out to complete by hand.

custom_fields.name: disposed_land_district
custom_fields.label: Land disposed of: district
custom_fields.prompt: Item 8(b): the district in which that land lies. Leave out if none.

custom_fields.name: disposed_land_acres
custom_fields.label: Land disposed of: acres
custom_fields.prompt: Item 8(b): the area of that land in acres. Leave out if none.

custom_fields.name: farming_experience
custom_fields.label: Farming experience of the transferee
custom_fields.prompt: Item 9: the transferee's farming experience, in the transferee's own words. Leave out to complete by hand.

execution.signer_label: owner, lessor, mortgagor, charger or authorized agent or agents, etc.

source.note: Form 1 in the Schedule to the Land Control Regulations (L.N. 23 of 1968), as at 2022-12-31. Extracted from the Regulations cached at procedures/_source/land-control-regulations.txt.
